title: Dataset adoption
description: A declared consumption of a dataset by a service on a specific contract version — the versioned twin of service.consumes_datasets, which only says THAT a service consumes a dataset. A relation entity like workload, since Port relations carry no properties. Declared, never observed: it records what a team states it runs and who verified it when; runtime evidence lives outside Toadie. Convention: the dataset should be among the consumer's consumes_datasets (not validated). Port-only.

contract_version.title: Contract version
contract_version.description: The data-contract version consumed, e.g. `2.1.0` (ODCS semver). Absent = undeclared.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this consumer stands on the contract version.

verified_at.title: Verified at
verified_at.description: When the declaration was last confirmed.
